page.notes: Show-through from the reverse in the right margin, not transcribed. Several damaged words in the verse: "Imp" line and "quicq;" line are illegible in part. "Esanita", "COTONE;" and "priscove" are doubtful. The opening parenthesis "(tronus" in line 1 is doubtful. Long s has been normalised to s, u/v adjusted per the rules. "volvas" and "renolve" were changed from the printed u.
